name: CrossPoint for PaperDIY (community port)
description: EPUB reader for the M5Stack PaperDIY (K159), built on CrossPoint Reader: library, fonts, dictionary, clippings, OPDS, Calibre, KOReader/CrossPoint Sync and web UI. GPLv3 firmware; only for PaperDIY, not PaperS3 or PaperColor. Not official M5Stack firmware.
keywords: EPUB, e-reader, CrossPoint, PaperDIY, M5Stack, MagSafe
author: dcarnicer
